title: 🔆🔅Tehran- September 3rd - Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, Head of the Iranian Judiciary, elaborate on the BRICS summit in a pre-departure briefing before heading to India.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran- September 3rd - Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, Head of the Iranian Judiciary, elaborate on the BRICS summit in a pre-departure briefing before heading to India."

""
"SOT1, Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei, Iran's Judiciary Chief, (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:41): “The world is transforming, the system of hegemony is declining, and independent countries can play a good role in this transformation. Islamic Iran and India, which share a very ancient civilization, an old culture, and common points, can once again play an effective role in this transformation and this global decline of unilateral world, by creating various voices and perspectives.""

" “Today, the system of hegemony and imperialist power, relying on its material strength, seeks to steer emerging developments back in the direction it desires. All independent countries, including the BRICS members, must be mindful of this and ensure that this system of hegemony and the voice of unilateralism are not allowed to persist.""

"SOT3, Gholamhossein Mohseni-Ejei, Iran's Judiciary Chief, (Farsi)-(01:16 - 02:09): “The the Zionist regime and the arrogant America, throughout last year and this year, imposed an illegal and illegitimate war on Islamic Iran, contrary to all international standards. Islamic Iran, praise be to God, has stood against this arrogant power for nearly half a century, namely 48 years. In these two wars also as admitted by friends, foes, and even many American officials, America did not achieve any of its goals, and the victor in the field was the Islamic Republic of Iran.
